purpose: Map Nift guarantees and the manually audited quantitative/reliability claims on the pinned public surfaces to retained evidence, enforcement, platform scope, limitations, and test-of-test status. Surface hashes force re-audit when those pages change.

baseline.note: BH1 is guarantee-durability infrastructure. Existing evidence remains valid unless falsified; UNPROVEN test-of-test status means guard liveness has not yet been demonstrated during this campaign.

guarantees.guarantee: For the retained Checkpoint 7 corpus, successful incremental output is byte-equivalent to a clean build from the same logical project state.
guarantees.scope: 720 complete output-tree comparisons over modified/hash/hybrid mutation sequences; not an enumeration of every possible project.
known_limits: Corpus-scoped
Current retained evidence is Linux-local rather than a per-push platform gate

guarantees.guarantee: Interrupting Nift mid-build (SIGKILL at multiple points during build-all) leaves the project crash-safe: tracked and config metadata remain valid JSON, the next build succeeds, and a further build converges to the clean output.
guarantees.scope: 3 incremental modes x 3 kill points each, plus clean-rebuild convergence.
known_limits: Kill points are coarse (0/20/80ms); scheduler-dependent timing is not exhaustively covered
Process-level kill only; power-loss/cache-flush simulation is out of scope

guarantees.guarantee: The retained Checkpoint 8 corpus exercises controlled filesystem/transaction failure, last-good output behavior, concurrent live-temp preservation, and stale-temp recovery.
guarantees.scope: 16 retained Linux cases including long-running build-auto recovery.
guarantees.test_of_test_note: The long-running stale-temp case was demonstrated to fail the previous once-per-process recovery implementation. Historical red behavior was observed, but no dedicated retained red-run artifact is currently referenced; BH3 must promote this guard.
known_limits: PID reuse is an accepted conservative cleanup limitation

guarantees.guarantee: When process identity is ambiguous because ownership uses PIDs, cleanup must fail conservatively by leaving a temporary rather than deleting a potentially live writer's file.
guarantees.scope: Transactional temporary cleanup only.
known_limits: Nift does not claim globally unique process identity across PID reuse

guarantees.guarantee: A deterministic adversarial sequence of incremental state transitions (content change, rm, mv, track, template change, tracked metadata change) leaves the output set exact across modified, hash, and hybrid modes: every expected page present and non-empty, no stale/orphan outputs, and incremental output equals a clean rebuild.
guarantees.scope: 3 incremental modes x 6 deterministic transitions each, plus clean-rebuild equivalence and template-propagation checks.
known_limits: Focused deterministic transition sequence; randomized fuzzing over longer horizons remains possible
Red-run evidence covers drop-page, stale-orphan, and stub defects; a crash mid-transition is BH7 territory

guarantees.guarantee: Adversarial parser/value/composition inputs (truncated or invalid JSON bound through @json, deep nesting, type mismatches, missing/null/coerced values, unicode, missing or cyclic @input fragments, @pathto edges) resolve with a controlled outcome: a successful build with correct output, or a controlled non-zero error. A hang, a signal termination, a sanitizer finding, or missing output is a defect.
guarantees.scope: 15 deterministic adversarial parser/value/composition cases.
known_limits: Focused deterministic case set; checkpoint-9 fuzzes the template plane, this guard covers the value/composition plane
Deep-nesting depth is bounded to 200; pathological resource exhaustion is not asserted

guarantees.guarantee: The retained Checkpoint 9 mutation/resource corpus either builds or fails in a controlled way without hangs, crashes, signals, sanitizer findings, or uncontrolled resource failure.
guarantees.scope: 1,217 retained n++ parser/resource cases.
known_limits: Mutation-family and resource-boundary scoped
Does not claim parser bug-freedom

guarantees.guarantee: Build output is contained within the output directory: adversarial content names (encoded traversal, parent references, spaces, unicode, deep nesting) never write outside public/, the project tree outside the output directory is unchanged by a build, and a read-only output directory yields a controlled failure (never a signal or hang).
guarantees.scope: 6 adversarial name families plus read-only output failure, on Linux.
known_limits: Linux only; platform-specific path semantics remain with the portable-equivalence corpus
Symlink following within content is Nift behavior, not a boundary violation

guarantees.guarantee: The same retained portable behavioral corpus produces normalized equivalent semantics on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
guarantees.scope: 18 portable Checkpoint 10 cases; explicitly platform-specific filesystem behavior is classified separately.
known_limits: Portable corpus only
Platform-specific contracts are not forced into false equivalence

guarantees.guarantee: The base init scaffold is functionally true: the generated project builds out of the box, config/tracked/template/content state is internally consistent (every @input reference resolves, content-ext->output-ext mapping holds), a clean rebuild reproduces the init'd public output and page metadata exactly, and builds are idempotent.
guarantees.scope: Base init scaffold reproducibility, consistency, and idempotency.
known_limits: Base scaffold only; target-specific scaffolds remain covered by init.target-shape-cross-platform
This Nift version emits no AI-context files from init, so AI-context truth is not asserted

guarantees.guarantee: Initializer target/scaffold output shapes, builds, and diagnostics agree with the target contract on native Linux, macOS, and Windows CI.
guarantees.scope: Supported init target/scaffold contract, not end-to-end provider deployment.
known_limits: Provider deployments are dogfooding/field evidence, not part of this guarantee

guarantees.guarantee: Incremental builds are change-proportional: a no-op build rewrites no output, and changing one source rebuilds exactly that page (no full re-render), measured structurally by mtime and content across modified/hash/hybrid modes.
guarantees.scope: 3 incremental modes x no-op + one-page-change probes.
known_limits: Structural change-proportionality only; wall-clock scaling remains covered by the near-linear benchmarks
Filesystem timestamp granularity makes sub-millisecond rewrites undetectable

guarantees.guarantee: Tracked-project loading remains near-linear over the retained scaling fixture and preserves duplicate/collision rejection.
guarantees.scope: Maintained tracking scaling benchmark and its generous ratio ceiling.
known_limits: Ratio guard, not a universal wall-clock guarantee

guarantees.guarantee: Changed-output full-build work remains near-linear on the retained large flat-output fixture.
guarantees.scope: 1,000→4,000 page changed-output scaling guard; identical-output fast path cannot hide the writer cost.
guarantees.test_of_test_note: The guard was demonstrated to fail the historical per-write stale-temp scan implementation. Historical red behavior was observed, but no dedicated retained red-run artifact is currently referenced; BH3 must promote this guard.
known_limits: Ratio guard, not a universal wall-clock guarantee

guarantees.guarantee: Transactional stale-temp recovery scans each distinct touched output parent at most once per recovery epoch.
guarantees.scope: Direct operation-count invariant exercised by the dedicated recovery-epoch guard.
known_limits: Structural scan-count invariant; does not promise idle background garbage collection

guarantees.guarantee: On the retained Linux 10,000-page memory fixture, measured peak RSS remains within the maintained 16 MiB guard.
guarantees.scope: Fixture-specific peak-RSS guard; RSS is not treated as a leak oracle.
known_limits: Known BH2 issue: missing /usr/bin/time currently exits 0, so SKIP can masquerade as PASS

guarantees.guarantee: The retained cross-component Valgrind campaign completed with zero reported Valgrind errors and no non-zero definite/indirect/possible leak bytes for the monitored invocations.
guarantees.scope: 19 monitored Nift invocations over the retained Checkpoint 6B workload.
known_limits: Historical/campaign evidence; not every push is Valgrind-gated

guarantees.guarantee: Configured Project Contract namespaces are project-wide and cannot be shadowed or overloaded by JSON bindings, loop variables, built-ins, or another contract binding.
guarantees.scope: Configured project-contract names and their documented binding collisions.
known_limits: Completed-run evidence retained at docs/evidence/bh10/ in BH10 reconciliation

guarantees.guarantee: The embedded Jsonic++ subtree can be checked against a canonical Jsonic++ checkout for exact Nift synchronization.
guarantees.scope: Sync contract exposed by test-jsonic-sync; automatic CI enforcement is not yet established.
known_limits: Requires an external canonical Jsonic++ checkout (JSONIC_DIR); no local completed-run evidence is registered in BH10, so its evidence class is not RETAINED
Automatic CI enforcement not established

guarantees.guarantee: Package-manager availability is reported as public only after the intended store version resolves and a fresh installation succeeds; workflow submission alone is not equivalent to availability.
guarantees.scope: Release/distribution reporting discipline and verification workflow.
known_limits: Distribution verification is manually dispatched rather than an every-push gate

guarantees.guarantee: The embedded Jsonic++ component has retained sanitizer/RSS lifetime testing and independent Valgrind confirmation for its maintained component corpus.
guarantees.scope: Jsonic++ component evidence only; does not by itself establish Nift end-to-end memory behavior.
known_limits: Component-scoped historical/campaign evidence

guarantees.guarantee: The embedded Minify++ component has retained sanitizer/RSS lifetime testing and independent Valgrind confirmation for its maintained multi-format component corpus.
guarantees.scope: Minify++ component evidence only; does not by itself establish Nift end-to-end memory behavior.
known_limits: Component-scoped historical/campaign evidence

guarantees.guarantee: Nift's retained lifecycle/watch memory campaign exercises sanitizer-backed project mutation/failure/repair paths plus long-running watch endurance without recorded sanitizer findings in the retained evidence.
guarantees.scope: Checkpoint 3 core lifecycle and Checkpoint 4 watch/large-project retained workloads.
known_limits: Campaign-scoped; RSS is not used as a standalone leak oracle

guarantees.guarantee: Pagination state transitions preserve incremental-vs-clean output equivalence across modified, hash, and hybrid modes.
guarantees.scope: 18 focused comparisons: six pagination state transitions under each incremental mode.
known_limits: Focused pagination fixture; broader incremental state-space remains BH4 territory
Output correctness (exact page set + nav total) is now asserted, so a stub or a build that under-produces pages in both incremental and clean runs is RED
Deleting the equivalence comparison specifically (m4 logic removal) remains a live mutation that is not statically catchable; accepted enforcement boundary
Mutation battery (stub / truncating / sabotaged nift) retained under docs/evidence/bh3/; test_of_test VERIFIED_GUARD via load-bearing proof (m3 inversion flips healthy to FAIL)

guarantees.guarantee: Parameter interpolation behavior is covered by a focused standalone contract module.
guarantees.scope: Checkpoint-specific 73-check parameter-interpolation module.
known_limits: Checkpoint count is historical evidence, not a current total-suite count

The standalone 73-check module lives in the regression suite and runs in full 3-repo executions; the nift CI_GATED path runs make test-contracts, whose contracts_smoke.sh also exercises interpolation bindings. Completed-run evidence retained at docs/evidence/bh10/.

guarantees.guarantee: The retained integration harness exercises shared JSON/schema/input state under parallel page builds and failure/repair transitions.
guarantees.scope: 120-page shared-data fixture with 12 workers across repeated forced builds and schema invalidation/repair.

known_discrepancies.summary: Several retained correctness/checkpoint families are not enforced on every relevant change. BH2 owns the enforcement-tier design rather than silently upgrading RETAINED evidence to CI_GATED.

Battle Tested says the current development tree exposes 30 focused Makefile targets, while the current Makefile contains more test-* targets after later additions. The page needs semantic reconciliation rather than blindly replacing 30 with the raw target count because some targets are aggregate/sanitizer helpers.

refs.needle: current development tree exposes 30 focused Makefile targets

known_discrepancies.summary: Production Readiness carries the historical 16-module project-contract checkpoint count while the independent regression suite has subsequently grown. The sentence may be intentionally historical, but BH10 must ensure readers cannot mistake it for the current suite total.

refs.needle: all 16 modern standalone black-box modules in that validation group

meta_guards.note: BH1 closed after DeepSeek independently attacked exact candidate 8419cec: 12 reviewer-authored corruption cases went red and the clean registry stayed green. Residual CI-semantic depth is explicitly deferred to BH2; guard/evidence semantic binding is BH3.

BH2: static scanner demonstrated RED against 6 injected false-green/vacuous fixtures across all five families and against 4 independent reviewer fixtures (sys.exit(0) skip, dead-code returncode, arbitrary-command pipeline, plain swallowed returncode); GREEN on the real tests/ + scripts/ trees (42 files). Static and pattern-based; runtime guard mutation is BH3.
